claims.evidence: The witness only saw a boxed, plastic-wrapped rectangular item with two white panels on the front; no readable PS4 branding/model text was reported.
No pricing/market comparison evidence was provided in the report.
The photos show only the outer box; accessories inside are not shown.
No game discs/cases or a list of included games is visible in the witness report.

risks.risk: Item may not be a PS4 (or may be a different model/region), since the report does not show readable brand/model identifiers.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the box front/back showing the exact product name/model (e.g., PS4 CUH-xxxx) and region/label text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown boxed console (worst case: not confirmed PS4), with no guarantee of compatibility or included items.

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (could be non-functional, missing parts, or damaged).
risks.proof: A short video of the console powering on and showing the home screen, plus a quick test of disc/game loading (or system settings screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / potentially faulty.

risks.risk: Accessories may be incomplete (missing controller, cables, HDMI, power cable, headset, etc.).
risks.proof: A photo/video laid out showing every included accessory individually (controllers, cables, manuals, etc.) with counts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete accessories (worst case: missing key cables/controllers).

risks.risk: The claim of '7 games inside' may be false or fewer games may be included.
risks.proof: A photo showing all game cases/discs clearly, or a video panning across the included games with titles visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as fewer/unknown games included (worst case: no games).

risks.risk: Box may be resealed/packaging may not reflect contents (outer packaging only is shown).
risks.proof: A clip showing the box opened and the contents inside before repacking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher risk of mismatch between box and contents.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the box front and back with readable PS4 branding and exact model/region text.
Send a short video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Show all accessories laid out with counts (controllers, cables, manuals).
Show all included games clearly (titles visible) or a video listing them one by one.
Show the box opened so the contents can be verified before payment.
response.reason: The witness report does not provide readable identifiers or any evidence of included accessories/games or working status. Without proof, a worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
